metadata.description: ir.filters knowledge - creating and managing filters

rules.rule: Always try to UPDATE existing filter before creating.

pattern.name: find_action_id
pattern.logic: Find action to attach filter to Favorites.
pattern.code_snippet: action = env['ir.actions.act_window'].search([('res_model', '=', model_name), ('view_mode', 'ilike', 'tree')], limit=1) vals['action_id'] = action.id if action else False
